settings.title: Who is this for?
settings.content:
This bundle is ideal for:

  • Anyone looking to brighten, firm, and rejuvenate their skin
  • Individuals with dull, dry, or uneven skin tone
  • Those experiencing early or mature signs of aging, like fine lines and wrinkles
  • People exposed to environmental stressors (UV, pollution, etc.)
  • Skincare lovers seeking a simple, effective day-to-night regimen
  • All skin types, including sensitive skin

settings.title: How to use it?
settings.content:
Morning (Daytime)

Cleanse and tone your face.

  • Apply 2–3 drops of Revital C Serum, pressing gently into the skin.
  • Follow with sunscreen to protect from UV damage.

Evening (Nighttime)

  • Cleanse and tone again if needed.
  • Apply 2–3 drops of the Anti-Aging Peptide Serum to dry skin.
  • Massage gently into face and neck.
  • Finish with your preferred moisturizer.

Use daily for optimal results.

settings.title: Benefits
settings.content:
Revital C Serum (Day):

  • Brightens and evens skin tone
  • Boosts collagen and elasticity
  • Reduces fine lines and wrinkles
  • Protects against environmental damage

Anti-Aging Peptide Serum (Night):

  • Deeply hydrates and plumps the skin
  • Promotes collagen production and elasticity
  • Provides antioxidant protection
  • Exfoliates and promotes cell renewal
  • Supports healing and skin repair
  • Improves overall skin texture and tone

settings.title: Ingredients
settings.content:
Revital C Serum:

Aqua (Filtered Water), Organic Vegetable Glycerin, Hyaluronic Acid, L-Ascorbic Acid (Vitamin C), Organic Aloe Barbadensis (Aloe Vera) Leaf Extract, Organic Camella Sinensis (White Tea) Leaf Extract, Ubiquinone, CoQ10, Tocopherol Acetate (Vitamin E), Citrus Aurantium Dulcis (Citrus) Peel Oil, Xanthan Gum, Sodium Benzoate.

Anti-Aging Peptide Serum:

Aqua (Filtered Water), Copper Peptides, Polypeptides, Hyaluronic Acid, Zinc, Tocopheryl Acetate (Vitamin E), Vegetable Glycerin, Carbomer, Citrus Aurantium Amara (Neroli), Salix Alba (Willow Bark Extract), Phenoxyethanol.

settings.heading: Here How Day and Night Serum works
settings.section_content:
Your skin needs different things at different times.
This duo is made to work with your skin’s natural rhythm — not against it.

Day Serum:
 Lightweight, energizing, and packed with ingredients that protect, hydrate, and prep your skin for the day ahead. Think of it as your daily skin armor.

Night Serum:
 Richer, deeper, and designed to repair while you rest. It helps restore moisture, improve texture, and support overnight cell renewal — so you wake up glowing.

Together, they’re like skincare soulmates — syncing with your skin’s clock for real results.

settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.title1: Can I use both serums every day?
settings.text1: Yes, both are designed for daily use—Revital C in the morning and the Anti-Aging Peptide Serum at night.
settings.title2: Will this bundle work for sensitive skin?
settings.text2: Absolutely! The formulas are gentle and suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin.
settings.title3: What’s the benefit of using two serums instead of one?
settings.text3: Each serum targets different concerns: Vitamin C protects and brightens during the day, while peptides repair and hydrate overnight—giving your skin 24/7 care.
settings.title4: Do I still need to use a moisturizer with these?
settings.text4: Yes, it's recommended to follow with a moisturizer to lock in hydration and boost results.
settings.title5: How long until I see visible results?
settings.text5: With consistent use, most people notice brighter, smoother, and healthier-looking skin within 2–4 weeks.
settings.title6: Can I use these serums with microcurrent devices?
settings.text6: Yes, both serums can be safely used with microcurrent and LED tools. Just ensure the serum is fully absorbed before using your device for best results.
